readerCopy.body: The verified account faces a story people prefer because it explains the fear, hope, or outrage more cleanly. Reporters, officials, or witnesses point to the available record; supporters of the other version point to intuition, motive, and details they believe were hidden. Mercury holds the facts that can be checked, while Neptune gives the unproven narrative emotional coherence and a devoted audience. The opposition puts evidence and belief across from each other where neither can be ignored. The facts may be stronger, but they still have to compete with a story that has already become meaningful to the people repeating it.
